description: This file contains utility functions for sanitizing and exporting various data structures related to chat flows, tools, assistants, templates, documents, and executions in a software project. It includes functions to sanitize data, stringify objects, and export combined data sets.

methods.name: sanitizeTool
methods.description: Sanitizes an array of tool objects by selecting specific properties.

methods.name: sanitizeChatflow
methods.description: Sanitizes chat flow objects, parsing flowData and generating export flow data.

methods.name: sanitizeVariable
methods.description: Sanitizes variable objects by selecting specific properties.

methods.name: sanitizeAssistant
methods.description: Sanitizes assistant objects by selecting specific properties.

methods.name: sanitizeCustomTemplate
methods.description: Sanitizes custom template objects, stringifying usecases and removing workspaceId.

methods.name: sanitizeDocumentStore
methods.description: Sanitizes document store objects by removing workspaceId.

methods.name: sanitizeExecution
methods.description: Sanitizes execution objects, removing workspaceId from nested agentflow if present.

methods.name: stringify
methods.description: Converts an object to a formatted JSON string.

methods.name: exportData
methods.description: Exports and sanitizes a comprehensive data object containing various project data types.
